query_referencia: SELECT ano_referencia, SUM(CAST(vlr_pag_fonte AS DECIMAL)) AS total FROM despesa_pagamento WHERE ano_referencia IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY ano_referencia ORDER BY ano_referencia;
query_gerada: SELECT ano_referencia, SUM(CAST(vlr_pag_fonte AS DECIMAL)) AS total_pago FROM despesa_pagamento WHERE ano_referencia IN (2024, 2025) AND COALESCE(nom_credor, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%' AND num_doc_credor NOT IN ('-1', '0') GROUP BY ano_referencia ORDER BY ano_referencia;
